headline: Share of large homes in transactions falls across seven major cities; unit prices of small homes rise faster than large ones - Finance
summary: Sinyi Realty Group data from 2021 to the first half of 2026 show shifts in transaction shares between small and large homes across seven major metropolitan areas, with small-home unit prices rising faster.
why: Housing transaction mix and prices reflect household demand and affordability, influencing developers, mortgage lending and property-linked equities.
